patch_description: Restructures the filter around a two-pass capped-NIS Kalman smoother: a forward adaptive Kalman run fused 50/50 with a time-reversed backward run, stitching the first half from the forward pass and the second half from the backward pass to reduce endpoint-phase error in the interior. The previous SG/convolution-style weighted quadratic regression is replaced by a constant-acceleration Kalman model with adaptive measurement noise (innovation-gated, capped NIS) which handles non-stationarity online. Downstream, the slope-gated reversal suppression and light 3-tap smoothing are retained (they were not implicated in prior regressions) and reorganized into a small modular pipeline. Backward pass is implemented by simple reversal of the input (no index arithmetic beyond np.concatenate / reversal), matching the recommended approach.
